description: This Hamburg data set for municipal heat planning maps, for each area unit used in the heat planning, whether at least one building is supplied through a heat network and which company operates that network. It also holds a company contact and information on the networks, such as network length, number of connections and CO2 factors. The metadata state that the heat network data are updated regularly, at least once a year, and that completeness depends on the data provided and on whether companies agreed to publication. The Hamburg Transparency Portal lists several versions, the latest modified on 27 July 2026, with GML and XSD downloads, CSV and GeoJSON exports, WFS and WMS services and an OGC API Features endpoint, plus earlier snapshots in the portal archive. Data are available free under the Data Licence Germany Attribution 2.0. Coverage is the city of Hamburg by heat planning area. Caveats: it shows areas and network summaries, not pipe routes or capacities, and some operators may be missing. Simulation uses are district heating coverage and operator data for heat planning and supply security studies. Related records: data-hamburg-gas-hydrogen-network-heat-planning is the matching gas and hydrogen layer.
